description: This file defines the main class EnterpriseApplication which initializes and starts an embedded Jetty server to serve a web application packaged in a shaded JAR file. It sets up the server, loads web resources from the classpath, and manages shutdown procedures.

classes.name: EnterpriseApplication
classes.description: Main class responsible for starting an embedded Jetty server to host a web application from resources within a shaded JAR.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that configures and starts the embedded Jetty server, setting up web application context and handling shutdown.

methods.name: resolvePort
methods.description: Determines the port number from system properties, defaulting to 8090 if not specified or invalid.
